## Documentation checklist

- [ ] `STATUS.md` updated
- [ ] `HANDOFF.md` updated
- [ ] `WORK_LOG.md` updated
- [ ] `ERROR_LOG.md` updated when failures occurred
- [ ] `DECISION_LOG.md` or ADR updated when decisions changed
- [ ] Master-plan status updated
- [ ] Score, claim, guardrail, and demo ledgers updated when evidence changed
- [ ] No secret or real patient data added
- [ ] Data modes are labeled accurately
- [ ] Displayed results are derived from authoritative artifacts
- [ ] Git and GitHub attribution policy verified
